brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: 9 full pieces stacked at 0,0 levels 0-2 plus 0,1 and 1,0 columns providing 3 storeys (levels 0,1,2) verified in get_build
Two notch drawer frames hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at bottom level: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 both at level 0 between base cells

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: Three open hex-bin-full bins at level 2: bin:0,0,2, bin:1,0,2, bin:0,1,2

finish.summary: Built L-shaped three-storey tower (central column 0,0 plus two adjacent columns) . Bottom storey has two notch drawer frames in the gaps between base cells; top storey (level 2) has three open full bins. Capped open faces and lock joints, meshClash clear.

M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
